status: frozen development plan; not executed by this change
motivation: V1 reflex-6 completed a valid pair and both answers scored 10/10, but the zg arm used root="/" in its only zg call, received an error, and answered using native tools. V1 does not demonstrate successful zg retrieval or a zg benefit.
hypothesis: The same explicit workspace-root instruction in both arms may prevent an incorrect repository root argument and allow the zg arm to retrieve from its prepared index.

only_protocol_change.append_to_shared_system_instructions: The repository root is exactly /workspace. Use /workspace for every repository-scoped root argument.
unchanged: native MCP tool schema and instructions

agent.name: claude-code
agent.repository_guidance: disabled using CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_CLAUDE_MDS and CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_AUTO_MEMORY; fresh HOME, empty setting sources

retrieval.query_policy: Preserve native main MCP schema and instructions (including its semantic-search guidance); no additional benchmark-specific tool forcing.
retrieval.index_setup: before timed solver; cloned per trial; separately recorded

evaluation.primary_mechanism: Record every zg root argument and whether each unique call returned a successful tool result; distinguish attempts, errors, successful calls, and unresolved calls.
evaluation.quality: Use the unchanged source-grounded rubric with profile hidden.
resources: wall seconds including container and MCP startup
evaluation.failure_policy: Keep task-level failed zg calls as observed behavior, not infrastructure errors. Keep both complete trajectories and all attempts, including failures.

retention_and_interpretation: Retain and report V1 unchanged alongside V2; never replace or delete V1 results.
This is a development iteration motivated by an observed V1 failure, not an independent preregistered confirmation.
One pair may show whether the root-argument mechanism works; it cannot establish statistical reliability.
Correct root arguments and successful retrieval do not guarantee better answer quality, lower token use, fewer calls, or lower latency.
Do not change the question or rubric, select a different task, discard an unfavorable run, or pool V1 and V2 as one unchanged protocol.
